_comment: K7 / R-K7-2(2): the OFF polarity of priv.trapCsr, restored to the supported matrix as a NAMED row. R-DK3 (2026-08-04) made trapCsr the schema default for both chips, and because only 7 of the 27 R-DK1 configs set `priv` explicitly, the flip silently re-based 19 rows AND removed the false polarity from the matrix entirely -- no config anywhere set it false, so the pre-P1 chip (what this project shipped until 2026-08-04) became untestable without adding a file. That is the F4b one-polarity shape the K-series exists to retire, arriving by the back door, and the lesson applies to a NEW default exactly as it did to the old one. This file is that one file. It is the ONLY configuration in the tree that exercises the trapCsr=false RTL arm: all ten trap-CSR addresses illegal, MRET/ECALL/EBREAK illegal, no trap CSR file, no standard delivery -- bit-identical to a pre-P1 chip, and 144 fewer flops per tile. Its images carry NO -DCORE_ENABLE_TRAPCSR, so the OFF arms of rocsrw/shapeq compile (both are deliberate FAILs by construction) -- which is precisely why both are trapCsr-TAGGED in the CATALOG and are NOT selected here. Prove it with: SUITE=full make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_notrapcsr.json
